basic_details.job_title: IIT Roorkee Research Associate (Electronics & Communication Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electronics & Communication Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee, invites applications from Indian nationals only for one Research Associate post in the project "Development of high efficiency c-bond power amplifer units", sponsored by the Defence Electronics Applications Laboratory (DEAL), Dehradun, DRDO. The post is for 8 months at Rs. 56000 - Rs. 75000 + HRA. It needs a Ph.D. degree, or 3 years of research, design and development experience after an M.Tech in Electronics and Communication or equivalent. Applications go by email to [email protected] by

how_to_apply: Prepare your application with a CV, degree certificates and experience certificates.
Make sure the application is submitted to the office of the Principal Investigator by 21/11/2026, 11:59 PM.
Bring the original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) to the interview for verification.
The notice gives the telephone number 8585992445 and lists the Principal Investigator's email as [email protected]. The notice does not print a subject line for the email.
important_instructions: Only Indian nationals can apply. Candidates must check their own eligibility before appearing for the interview. Original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) must be brought at the time of interview for verification. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience.

rows.essential_qualification: Ph.D. degree or having 3 years of research, design, and development experience after an M.Tech in Electronics and Communication or equivalent with a CGPA above 7.0 (on a 10.0 scale) with a percentage greater than 70% aggregate at the M.Tech level in the relevant area
rows.desirable: Exposure and interest in radio frequency circuit design during Ph.D. research work will be given preference

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments printed in the notice are Rs. 56000 - Rs. 75000 + HRA. The duration of the position is 8 months. The notice does not say how the amount within the range is decided.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Research Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: The candidate will be involved in research and development activities related to RF circuits and wireless transmitter design, with a focus on hardware implementation. He/She should produce high-quality research publications.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Roorkee Research Associate
content_sections.text: Prepare your application with a CV, degree certificates and experience certificates. Email the application to [email protected] . Make sure the application is submitted to the office of the Principal Investigator by 21/11/2026, 11:59 PM. Bring the original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) to the interview for verification. The notice gives the telephone number 8585992445 and lists the Principal Investigator's email as [email protected] . The notice does not print a subject line for the email.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice says candidates desiring to appear for the interview should submit their applications with the documents above. Shortlisting will be based on the applicant's academic performance and experience in the relevant area, etc. Candidates must ensure before appearing for the interview that they are eligible for the position they intend to apply for. The notice does not mention the interview date or venue. On equal qualifications and experience, preference will be given to SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Associate vacancies are there at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: There is 1 Research Associate vacancy in the Electronics & Communication Engineering project under Prof. Karun Rawat.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date is 21 November 2026, 11:59 PM. The application must reach the office of the Principal Investigator by email.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Roorkee Research Associate post?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. degree, or 3 years of research, design, and development experience after an M.Tech in Electronics and Communication or equivalent, with a CGPA above 7.0 (on a 10.0 scale) and a percentage greater than 70% aggregate at the M.Tech level in the relevant area.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the Research Associate?
faq.answer: The emoluments are Rs. 56000 - Rs. 75000 + HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the emoluments are printed as Rs. 56000 - Rs. 75000 + HRA, so HRA is listed in addition to the amount.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email your application with CV, degree certificates and experience certificates to [email protected] by 21 November 2026, 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the position?
faq.answer: The duration of the Research Associate position is 8 months.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be shortlisted?
faq.answer: Shortlisting will be based on the applicant's academic performance and experience in the relevant area, etc. Candidates then appear for an interview, where original certificates are verified.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any preference for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.
